name: Kubernetes
attack_surface: Kubelet API, Kube-apiserver endpoints, service account tokens inside pods
common_misconfigurations: Anonymous access enabled on Kubelet ports
Over-privileged service account policies (e.g. cluster-admin role mapping)
Missing container runtime execution limits (e.g. hostNetwork or privileged containers)
validation_methods: Attempt anonymous listing on Kubelet API paths
Check token permissions using kubectl auth can-i options
evidence_requirements: Raw API response showing pod listings or shell execution output
Kubectl trace logs showing allowed admin commands
false_positive_indicators: Apiserver endpoints returning unauthorized errors after initial handshake
reporting_guidance: High priority focus area. Remote code execution inside containers or escape to node is critical risk.
